# [CS015] CORS Allows Credentials From Any Origin (cors-wildcard-credentials)

CORS reflects any origin while allowing credentials.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-942](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/942.html) |
| **OWASP** | A02:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Allowing credentials together with a wildcard or a reflected Origin lets any website read authenticated responses from the API in the visitor's browser.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", r.Header.Get("Origin"))
w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true")
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
if origin := r.Header.Get("Origin"); allowedOrigins[origin] {
	w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", origin)
	w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Credentials", "true")
	w.Header().Add("Vary", "Origin")
}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [cors-wildcard-credentials]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    cors-wildcard-credentials: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore cors-wildcard-credentials -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** cors-wildcard-credentials
```
